sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Proposal: three-year full-allocation package for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We propose one complete package: EUR 30.50/unit, 23,400 units/year, 36 months, 56-day lead time, payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01. The full annual quantity becomes binding once mutually agreed, so our commitment covers 23,400 units in each of the three contract years. We offer the long commitment and the 56-day delivery window together, in exchange for this price and full allocation.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Could you approve this complete long-term package, seeking internal approval if needed?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Proposal: three-year full-allocation package for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your internal cost estimates do not reflect our specialized manufacturing processes and cannot dictate our pricing. 

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units per year, the 36-month contract term, and the 56-day lead time. For this package, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. 

In summary, our Angebot consists of a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – revised complete package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for accepting 23,400 units/year, 36 months and the 56-day lead time. We understand our estimate cannot fully capture your specialised processes.

We raise our proposed price from EUR 30.50 to EUR 30.96/unit. The binding commitment stays unchanged: 23,400 units/year for 36 months, 56-day lead time, payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01.

Our September forecast records a 10.1% change (fc:340010@2026-09). That forecast is a planning record. The 23,400 units/year is our new proposed binding requirement, separate from it.

We are prepared to conclude on this complete package if you can support it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – revised complete package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and the referenced forecast change, though the latter does not impact our pricing structure. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We are prepared to reduce our price to EUR 31.40 per unit for the requested package of 23,400 units per year over 36 months with a 56-day lead time. This represents a significant concession on our part and reflects our commitment to reaching an agreement. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
